chunks.text: Acme Handbook. Acme sells smart lamps online.
Acme sells smart lamps online. Our head office is in Berlin.
Our head office is in Berlin. Refunds.
Refunds. You can return a product within 14 days of delivery.
You can return a product within 14 days of delivery. The product must be unused.
The product must be unused. Refund money goes back to the original card.
Refund money goes back to the original card. It takes 5 to 7 business days to arrive.
It takes 5 to 7 business days to arrive. Shipping costs are not refunded.
Shipping costs are not refunded. Damaged products are refunded in full, including shipping.
Damaged products are refunded in full, including shipping. Shipping.
Shipping. We ship to all EU countries and the UK.
We ship to all EU countries and the UK. Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 days.
Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 days. Express delivery takes 1 day and costs 9 euros.
Express delivery takes 1 day and costs 9 euros. Orders over 50 euros ship for free.
Orders over 50 euros ship for free. Warranty.
Warranty. All lamps have a 2 year warranty.
All lamps have a 2 year warranty. The warranty covers electrical faults.
The warranty covers electrical faults. It does not cover water damage or broken glass caused by the customer.
It does not cover water damage or broken glass caused by the customer. Accounts.
Accounts. To reset your password, use the Forgot password link on the login page.
To reset your password, use the Forgot password link on the login page. Accounts with no login for 3 years are deleted.
Accounts with no login for 3 years are deleted. We email you 30 days before deletion.
